title: Indian Shuttlers Face Japan Quarter-Final Challenge at Asian Games
indian_angle: Indian men's and women's badminton teams have learned their potential quarter-final opponents at the Asian Games, with Japan looming as a tough challenge.
summary: The Asian Games badminton draws revealed that both Indian men's and women's teams are likely to encounter strong Japanese opposition in the quarter-finals, following their initial matches against Kazakhstan and Bangladesh respectively.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for developing coaching talent within India, directly impacting the future of Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is currently conducting its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Courses at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, scheduled from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026 Released by BAI
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic team competition, providing a platform for Indian players to compete nationally.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has officially released the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, detailing the rules and framework for this important domestic event.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for Junior World Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This change affects the composition of India's potential team for the BWF World Junior Championships, a significant event for young Indian talent.
summary: A modification has been announced regarding a women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, impacting the final roster for the Cairo event.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Commences for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's promising junior players for international competition at the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A dedicated coaching camp for the Indian team slated to compete in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 has begun at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, aimed at honing the skills of young players.
